records.Name: Volunteer Sign-Up
records.Description__c: Collects a volunteer's details, where they would like to help and when they are free. Writes the person, their employer and an affiliation between them, and shows a guardian step for anyone under 18.

records.Name: Event Registration
records.Description__c: A simple sign-up for a one-day open house: contact details, the session, guests and a meal question that shows only when needed.
